list_components.description: Returns the full list of items in storage: name, SKU, category, quantity, minimum stock, storage (storageId) and cell address (cellAddress, e.g. "A1"). Use it to find an item or check availability before reserving/ordering. Cell addressing: letter = column (A=column 0, B=column 1, …), number = row (row 0 → 1); the cell at row 0, column 0 is "A1". Always use ready-made addresses (cellAddress from tool responses or page context), do not compute them yourself. Each item also carries reservedTotal (quantity reserved across projects) and onOrder (quantity on active orders not yet delivered). Pass an optional query to search server-side by name, SKU, description, category and custom fields.

params.query: Optional free-text search filter (name, SKU, description, category, custom fields); omit to list everything.

find_components_by_sku.description: Finds existing items with the exact given SKU (case-insensitive). Use it to check for a duplicate item before creating a new one. Returns id, name, sku and the canonical ref of each match (empty list when none).

get_component_movements.description: Returns the movement history (receipts/withdrawals/adjustments) for the specified item. Use it to audit stock.

create_component.description: Creates a new item in the inventory. Only the name is required; category, quantity and minimum stock are optional (quantity and minimum stock default to 0; a minimum of 0 disables low-stock tracking). To place an item in a SPECIFIC cell of the storage grid, pass storageId AND cell (address, e.g. "B1") — without cell the item lands in storage without a cell binding. If the user has opened a cell (see page context), place it exactly there. Cell addressing: letter = column (A=column 0, B=column 1, …), number = row (row 0 → 1); the cell at row 0, column 0 is "A1". Always use ready-made addresses (cellAddress from tool responses or page context), do not compute them yourself.

params.name: Item name
params.cell: Address of the storage grid cell to place the item in (e.g. "B1"). Requires storageId. Preferred method. Optional.
params.row: Alternative to cell: row number (0-based). Specify together with col. Optional.
params.col: Alternative to cell: column number (0-based). Specify together with row. Optional.
params.description: Item description. Plain text or HTML. Optional.
params.links: Array of useful links; each item is an object { label, url }. Optional.
params.linkItem: A useful link: { label: display text, url: address }.
params.customFields: Array of custom characteristics; each item is an object { key, value }. Optional.
params.customFieldItem: A characteristic: { key: name, value: value }.
params.unit: Measurement unit code (pcs, m, g, ml, roll, …). Optional; defaults to pcs.
params.categoryId: Id (or mk:// reference) of an EXISTING item category. Call list_item_categories first and pick from it — never invent a category; if nothing fits, leave this empty and let the user create one.
params.propertyValues: Values for the category's typed properties, as an object keyed by property id: {"<propertyId>": value}. Ids come from list_item_categories. Values that do not fit the declared type are ignored.
params.imageUrls: The item's photographs, as a list of already-stored "/api/uploads/:id" URLs (for example ones another tool returned). The list IS the whole set — the first entry becomes the cover. Omit it for an item with no pictures; up to 5. Optional.
params.imageUrlItem: One already-stored "/api/uploads/:id" photograph URL. It must be a picture the person actually provided — one this conversation carried, or one another tool returned. A URL that is invented, or that belongs to another item or project, is refused and the whole call fails.

move_component.description: Moves an existing item: to another storage (storageId) and/or to a specific grid cell (cell, e.g. "B1"). Use it when the user asks to move an item to a cell/storage. To remove the cell binding, pass clearCell=true. Cell addressing: letter = column (A=column 0, B=column 1, …), number = row (row 0 → 1); the cell at row 0, column 0 is "A1". Always use ready-made addresses (cellAddress from tool responses or page context), do not compute them yourself.

params.componentId: Identifier of the item being moved
params.storageId: Destination storage ID. Optional if only the cell of the current storage changes.
params.cell: Address of the target grid cell (e.g. "B1"). Preferred method. Optional.
params.row: Alternative to cell: row number (0-based). Specify together with col. Optional.
params.col: Alternative to cell: column number (0-based). Specify together with row. Optional.
params.clearCell: true — remove the item's cell binding (keep only the storage). Optional.

update_component.description: Updates an item's attributes: name, SKU, category, minimum stock, description, photo. Does NOT change the on-hand quantity (use adjust_component_quantity) nor the storage/cell placement (use move_component). Pass componentId and only the fields you want to change.

params.componentId: Identifier of the item being updated
params.name: New name. Optional.
params.unit: Measurement unit code (pcs, m, g, ml, roll, …). Optional; defaults to pcs.
params.categoryId: Id (or mk:// reference) of an existing item category; an empty string removes the item from its category. Values the new category does not define are kept as free-form key-value pairs, never deleted.
params.propertyValues: Values for the category's typed properties, as an object keyed by property id. Only the properties passed are written; the rest keep their current values.
params.imageUrls: REPLACES the item's photographs with this list of already-stored "/api/uploads/:id" URLs — it is the whole set, not an addition, and the first entry becomes the cover. An EMPTY list removes every photograph. Omit the parameter to leave the pictures untouched; up to 5. Optional.
params.imageUrlItem: One already-stored "/api/uploads/:id" photograph URL. It must be a picture the person actually provided — one this conversation carried, or one another tool returned. A URL that is invented, or that belongs to another item or project, is refused and the whole call fails.

adjust_component_quantity.description: Changes the quantity of an item in storage by the specified delta (positive or negative) and records a stock movement.

params.type: Movement type: ADJUSTMENT (default), PURCHASE (restock), USED (consumed) or RETURN (returned). Optional.
params.note: Optional note stored with the movement.

delete_component.description: Deletes an item from storage. WARNING: destructive action. The operation is forbidden if the item is used in projects, tasks or orders.

params.componentId: Identifier of the item being deleted

list_restock_needed.description: Returns items that need restocking, each with a suggested buy quantity (shortfall) — where free stock cannot cover the min-stock threshold or the unmet project demand. Use it to build a shopping list.

reserve_component.description: Reserves the specified quantity of an item for a project (removes it from the general warehouse).

consume_component.description: Writes off (consumes) reserved stock into the project — the items leave inventory for good. Draws down the reserved quantity of the project link and records a USED movement. Does not change the item free quantity (already removed at reservation).

params.qty: Quantity to write off (from the reserved amount)

return_component.description: Returns unused reserved stock from the project back to the general warehouse. Draws down the reserved quantity and increases the item's free stock, recording a RETURN movement.

params.qty: Quantity to return (from the reserved amount)

list_item_categories.description: Lists the item categories with their own typed properties: id, name, parent, whether the category inherits its ancestors' properties, and each property's type, unit, options and whether it becomes a tag. Call this before creating or updating an item so the category and property ids are real.

create_item_category.description: Creates an item category. A category owns a set of typed properties that every item in it carries; a child category adds to what it inherits from its parent.

params.name: Category name as the user would write it.
params.parentId: Id (or mk:// reference) of the parent category. Omit for a top-level category.
params.inheritProperties: Whether items in this category also carry the ancestors' properties. Defaults to true.

update_item_category.description: Renames an item category, moves it under another parent, or switches inheritance of the ancestors' properties on or off.

params.categoryId: Id (or mk:// reference) of the category to change.
params.name: New name.
params.parentId: Id (or mk:// reference) of the new parent; an empty string moves the category to the top level.
params.inheritProperties: Whether items in this category also carry the ancestors' properties.

add_category_property.description: Adds a typed property to a category. The name must be free along the whole inheritance chain — a name already used by an ancestor or by an inheriting sub-category is rejected.

params.categoryId: Id (or mk:// reference) of the category the property belongs to.
params.name: Property name as it should appear on the item card.
params.type: text, number or select. A select property carries a closed list of allowed values.
params.unit: Unit of measurement, for number properties only. Display-only and never converted, so "Ohm" and "kOhm" are two different properties.
params.required: Marks the property as expected. It never blocks saving — an item missing it is only flagged as incomplete.
params.options: Allowed values, for select properties only.

update_category_property.description: Changes a category property: its name, unit, whether it is expected, its allowed values, or whether it becomes a tag.

params.propertyId: Id of the property to change (from list_item_categories).
params.name: New property name.
params.type: New property type (text, number or select). Values stored under the old type move into the item’s free-form specs.
params.order: Position of the property in the category list, from 0.
params.unit: Unit of measurement, for number properties only.
params.required: Marks the property as expected; it never blocks saving.
params.options: Allowed values, for select properties only.

delete_item_category.description: Deletes an item category. Items in it are NOT deleted — they lose the category, and the values of its properties are kept on each item as free-form key-value pairs. Sub-categories move up to this category's parent.

params.categoryId: Id (or mk:// reference) of the category to delete.

delete_category_property.description: Deletes a property from a category. The values items already carry are NOT lost — each is kept on its item as a free-form key-value pair.

params.propertyId: Id of the property to delete (from list_item_categories).
